family: All Boolean sign tables through n=3; signed two-threshold selectors; disjoint products of point-defect sign functions
domain: n=1,2,3 all tables/all orders; selectors with 2..5 symmetric data bits and all threshold pairs; point-defect products L=1..4, m=1..5, L*m<=10
case_count: 1572 table/order cases; 54 selector cases; 15 product parameter cases (counts rechecked by program)
symmetry: No quotient; exact full Walsh transform; all permutations only for n<=3, identity order for selectors and three fixed permutations for products
arithmetic: Integer Walsh coefficients, Fraction squared spectra/influence/conditional means; rational atanh logarithm enclosures for decisive inequalities
purpose: Regression validation of analytic universal reduction, normalized Euler rank-minus-KL identity, bounded-height relative-noise inequality, and product obstruction identities; not a proof by finite extrapolation
